summary: First E2E test of Grace Cares CIC platform. Backend: 38/38 executed tests passed (5 skipped due to stock reservations by prior test runs — 30-minute reservation TTL is by design, not a bug). Frontend: home, shop, product detail, cart, checkout with VAT declaration, admin login+dashboard, registration+account tabs, resources, events, donate all render and integrate correctly. VAT line-level engine verified across 5 scenarios (standard, eligible+decl, eligible-no-decl, mixed, do-not-qualify). Stock oversell prevention returns 409 as required. Role-based access enforced: content_admin cannot see /admin/vat-declarations or sensitive enquiries; super_admin sees all. Xero mock queue + idempotency verified. Stripe checkout URLs generated. Password reset invalid-token rejected. Newsletter consent enforced.

issues: Seed image for 'Bedside Commode' looks like a bathroom grab-bar rail rather than a commode — likely stock-image mismatch in seed_data.py; consider updating.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: httpOnly + secure + SameSite=None cookies correctly set on login/register — good.
shop.py compute_order enforces declaration_valid via BOTH product.vat_relief_eligible AND declaration completeness — VAT correctness confirmed via /api/checkout/quote for 5 scenarios.
content.py public_event() strips online_link — verified /api/events response contains no online_link.
admin.py xero_sync_item is idempotent (returns already_synced=true for synced items) and 85% simulated success — verified.
seed_admin() correctly re-hashes password if changed and forces role=super_admin — verified via login.
Stripe secret key present but STRIPE_MODE=test; server-computed total in pence used correctly for line_items.
Reservation TTL (30 min) means repeated test runs deplete seed stock; consider a test-only reset endpoint OR shorter TTL in test env for CI. Not a production bug.
server.py CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — works with browsers because origin is echoed, but consider tightening to explicit FRONTEND_URL for production hardening.
